items.content: 🚨 NEW EXPERIMENT 🚨 Dreambeans is a new, experimental mobile app that uses Personal Intelligence to connect to your Google apps. Every day, it delivers collections of personalized stories, surfacing things you might otherwise miss, alongside topics that are relevant to you, to help you dive deeper into the things you care about most. Available starting today for eligible US-based Google AI Ultra users (+18), with an open waitlist found on our website below! Learn more at https://t.co/jCdAzMHvOD
